digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and T10 detection gate
propositions: T3 and T10 criteria never block in production due to missing blocking configuration despite audit evidence of actionable findings; enabling blocking at 0.90 block_threshold with conservative pilot approach to bound blast radius.

T10 findings require class scoping to prevent low-severity findings from reaching blocking threshold; severity guidance in plan_review_T10.md restricts MAJOR-class findings (destructive apply, wildcard grants, plaintext secrets, unauthenticated services) to prevent advisory-level noise.

T10 detection overlay gate must fire on infrastructure and GitHub Actions workflow plans to pre-gate LLM review; implemented as DetGateRule with terraform/cloudformation/kubernetes/IAM/IaC vocabulary triggers without file_impact arms.

Pinned unit test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py must be updated to reflect T3 and T10 blocking enablement; full routing table and approved-blocking-criteria set require synchronized changes across multiple test files.

New test suite validates blocking behavior: T3 and T10 findings at priority 0.92 block while findings at 0.85 remain advisory; T10 DetGateRule fires on infra fixtures and skips non-infra plans with det_gated coverage entry.
